mapper.select: select COALESCE(sum(i.refund_qty),0) from t_refund_item i join t_refund_order a on a.refund_no=i.refund_no left join t_refund_info r on r.refund_no=i.refund_no where i.order_item_id=#{orderItemId} and (a.status='SUCCESS' or r.refund_status='SUCCESS') and a.refund_no <> #{excludeRefundNo}
